verses.text: Adam slept with his wife Eve, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain. She said, "With the LORD's help I have brought a man into the world."
Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Abel looked after sheep, and Cain worked the soil.
After some time, Cain brought some of the crops from the ground as an offering to the LORD.
Abel also brought an offering. He brought the best parts of some of the firstborn lambs from his flock. The LORD was pleased with Abel and his offering,
but he was not pleased with Cain and his offering. So Cain became very angry, and his face looked gloomy.
Then the LORD said to Cain, "Why are you angry? Why do you look so gloomy?
If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you do not do what is right, sin is waiting at your door like a wild animal. It wants to control you, but you must master it."
Cain said to his brother Abel, "Let's go out to the field." While they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.
Then the LORD said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" "I don't know," he answered. "Am I supposed to look after my brother?"
The LORD said, "What have you done? Listen! Your brother's blood is crying out to me from the ground.
Now you are under a curse, and you are driven from the ground, which opened its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand.
When you work the ground, it will no longer give you good crops. You will be a restless wanderer on the earth."
Cain said to the LORD, "My punishment is more than I can bear.
Today you are driving me away from the land, and I will be hidden from your presence. I will be a restless wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me."
But the LORD said to him, "No. If anyone kills Cain, he will be punished seven times over." Then the LORD put a mark on Cain, so that no one who found him would kill him.
So Cain went away from the LORD's presence and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
Cain slept with his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Cain was building a city at the time, and he named it Enoch, after his son.
Enoch had a son named Irad. Irad was the father of Mehujael. Mehujael was the father of Methushael, and Methushael was the father of Lamech.
Lamech married two women. One was named Adah and the other was named Zillah.
Adah gave birth to Jabal. He was the first of those who live in tents and keep livestock.
His brother's name was Jubal. He was the first of all who play the harp and the flute.
Zillah also had a son, Tubal-Cain. He made all kinds of tools out of bronze and iron. Tubal-Cain's sister was Naamah.
Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, listen to me. Wives of Lamech, hear what I say. I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for hurting me.
If Cain is avenged seven times, then Lamech will be avenged seventy-seven times."
Adam slept with his wife again, and she gave birth to a son. She named him Seth, because she said, "God has given me another child in place of Abel, since Cain killed him."
Seth also had a son, and he named him Enosh. At that time people began to call on the name of the LORD.
